SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-12: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — Profiling, Shareable View Definition, Tabular View Definition, Mappings, XML, JSON. Test these items: Shareable and Tabular profile-required metadata handling, JSON representation uses official field names and round-trips through parser/generator inputs, XML representation support is implemented or explicitly documented as unsupported, canonical URL, version, status, and profile metadata do not break execution, FHIR mapping/profile fields are retained, ignored, or rejected consistently with documented behavior, official examples serialize and parse consistently across supported formats. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.1.0-pre ShareableViewDefinition profile requires url 1..1, name 1..1, fhirVersion 1..*, and select.column.type 1..1; TabularViewDefinition constrains columns with no-collections and primitives-only; ViewDefinition JSON defines meta/profile metadata and supported logical-model field names.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe .ai_loop/.temp/qa/sof_vd12_skeptic_probe.py: parser and SQLGenerator reject a direct ShareableViewDefinition dataclass missing url/name/fhirVersion/column.type, but ViewDefinition.to_dict() emitted {'meta': {'profile': [ShareableViewDefinition]}, 'resource': 'Patient', 'select': [{'column': [{'path': 'id', 'name': 'id'}]}]} and validate_view_definition(...) returned []. A TabularViewDefinition direct dataclass with column.type='HumanName' also emitted invalid JSON and returned []. Expected: public serializer should not emit profile-invalid official JSON, and permissive validation should warn for the same supported profile constraints.
issues.root_cause: Supported profile validation was wired into strict parse and SQL generation paths, but the public direct serializer and permissive validator did not reuse that profile constraint check.
issues.resolution: ViewDefinition.to_dict() now calls validate_supported_view_profiles() before returning official JSON, and validate_view_definition() now reports supported Shareable/Tabular profile violations as warnings when the direct select tree is structurally inspectable. Added focused direct serializer and permissive validator regressions.
